detail: Logs record sample paths and read counts, not historical FASTQ SHA-256 values. Current recovered files are frozen by this archive.
The selected benchmark uses TIC files corrected after the original TACTIC run. Preserve these exact tables, FASTA files, and membership maps; an unmodified upstream rerun need not recreate them.

Driver snapshot names ghcr.io/mpourjam/tactic-pipeline:0.7.5-alpha. Container digest, image, licensed binaries, and container-internal spike reference FASTA are not frozen here. No upstream pipeline was run.
TACTIC logs record input before internal spike removal. Copies renamed *_with_spike.fastq.gz are retained under trimmed_but_spiked; later DADA2 input copies are spikefree. Both stages are included.

Some original MANIFEST and driver snapshots contain obsolete names or early exit statements. pipeline_inputs.tsv and sample_input_links.tsv identify the resolved files; scripts are preserved as evidence, not an automatic upstream replay recipe.

Older membership-only Analysis_20260510_115118 and Analysis_20260511_170504 directories were preserved under input_manifest/legacy_analysis_memberships. Only the selected Analysis_20260511_170817 run remains under data/communities, preventing mtime-based discovery from skipping four methods.

SRR13005964 retains 147918 FASTQ pair records. The recorded Bowtie2 summary also says 147918 total, consisting of 147917 paired and one unpaired read. The R2 mate of SRR13005964.10542 has zero length; TACTIC's summary reports the paired subset. Original files are preserved.

Generated per-community R scripts, pair lists, and driver snapshots are included, but the exact historical per-run positional R arguments and an immutable DADA2 container digest were not retained. Driver scripts contain early exits and are provenance snapshots, not a verified upstream replay recipe.
